scope: Metadata-only preservation of five genuine source-Python/original-R two-grid products. Original source execution, numerical review, pure correspondence writer and saved-ledger review remain four distinct epochs. Original numerical and writer aggregate failures remain literal; successful stages are not promoted to whole-job success. Full original input hashes, exact historical source and current-context Git recoveries are separate; no whole-current-tree equivalence. Private193 source bytes/runtime libraries are not redistributed. Legacy installed_lra/raw REPORT vocabulary is preserved and does not establish installed-distribution execution. Full1128 study, independent vegetation/Nordic accuracy, rights, human and official release acceptance remain open.
